prompt: Provide the Android `network_security_config.xml` for an application that talks to an external API backend.
raw_response:
```xml
network_security_config.xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<network-security-config>
    <!-- Base configuration: deny cleartext traffic by default -->
    <base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="false">
        <trust-anchors>
            <!-- Trust only system CAs (no user-installed CAs) -->
            <certificates src="system" />
        </trust-anchors>
    </base-config>

    <!-- Configuration for the external API backend -->
    <domain-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="false">
        <!-- Replace with your actual API domain -->
        <domain includeSubdomains="true">api.example.com</domain>
        <trust-anchors>
            <certificates src="system" />
        </trust-anchors>
    </domain-config>

    <!-- Optional: If you need to support a development/staging environment over HTTP -->
    <!--
    <domain-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true">
        <domain includeSubdomains="false">staging.example.com</domain>
    </domain-config>
    -->
</network-security-config>
```
